name: MelonLoader and BepInEx together
description: Routes each mod to the right loader when both are picked.

features: Installs mods for MelonLoader and BepInEx, and works out which loader each mod is for (see [Which loader a mod goes to](#which-loader-a-mod-goes-to)).
Installs either loader itself when you drop its release on the Mods page, and warns when neither or both are installed.
notes: `src/loaders/routing.ts` decides which loader a mod goes to. `src/melonloader/` and `src/bepinex/` hold each loader's folders, files and installers, and `BEPINEX` in `src/bepinex/constants.ts` holds the game's Unity build. Check them for {{gameName}}.
